label: Now Developing
items: The Senate ended plenary work on the ₱7.2 trillion 2027 budget, including a PhilHealth boost, while the impeachment trial pauses for budget season.
Courts denied Marcoleta bail, the Supreme Court dismissed Duterte arrest petitions, and the ICC trial opens November 30 as a local truth commission documents thousands of drug-war killings.
PAGASA warns drought will spread to dozens more provinces as Manila pushes back on Trump's US-only import claim and agencies flag recruitment scams tied to war zones.
